question: What is the revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, of the orders placed from 2026-06-01 00:00:00 to 2026-06-02 00:00:00?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-06-01 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-02 00:00:00';

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-24 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE date('2026-09-24') >= date(c.birth_date, '+25 years')
  AND date('2026-09-24') < date(c.birth_date, '+26 years');

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?

);

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-25 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-25
  (
    -- Age = 25 if birth_date's year + 25 <= 2026 and (birth_date's month, day) <= (09-25)
    -- and (birth_date's month, day) > (09-25) is false (i.e., not after)
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + 25 <= 2026
    AND
    (
      CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
      <=
      CAST('2026-09-25' AS INTEGER) * 10000 + 9 * 100 + 25
    )
    AND NOT (
      CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) * 100 + CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) AS INTEGER)
      >
      CAST('2026-09-25' AS INTEGER) * 10000 + 9 * 100 + 25
    )
  );

question: What is the total revenue excluding VAT, in euro cents, generated by customers who are exactly 25 years old on the reference date 2026-09-26 (all their orders)?
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  -- Compute age on 2026-09-26
  (
    -- Age = year difference
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) -
    -- Subtract 1 if birthday hasn't occurred yet this year on 2026-09-26
    CASE
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) > '09' THEN 1
      WHEN SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 6, 2) = '09' AND SUBSTR(c.birth_date, 9, 2) > '26' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) = 25;
